Financial Controller – Romania & Hungary with English 
 CEE Region | International Finance Team 
 We are looking for a Financial Controller who wants to step up , take ownership, and grow into a truly independent finance role – while still being part of a supportive and experienced CEE finance community .
 This role covers Hungary and Romania , two diverse and strategically important markets within our region. It is ideal for someone with around 3+ years of experience in controlling or financial analysis who is ready to move beyond pure reporting and become a true business partner .
 🔍 Your Role & Responsibilities 
Full responsibility for financial reportin g for Austria, Hungary and Romania
Ensuring compliance with IFRS and local GAAP requirements 
Active participation in budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis 
Supporting process improvements and internal controls 
Delivering financial insights that support management decision-making
Support sales teams with pricing analysis and preparation of customer‑specific cost calculations
Close cooperation with sales teams, local management and financial teams 
 🎯 Your Profile 
 3+ years of experience in controlling, finance or financial analysis
Solid knowledge o f IFRS and experience with local GAAP 
 English at B2 level or higher (daily working language)
 German language skills are an advantage
Experience with or exposure t o CEE markets is an advantage
Strong analytical mindset, structured thinking and growing independence
University degree i n Finance, Accounting, Economics or similar 
 🌍 Why Join US 
A role with real ownership and visible impact across multiple countries
International environment within a collaborative CEE finance team 
Strong support, knowledge sharing and learning opportunities
Exposure to different markets, cultures and accounting environments 
A company that valu es ethics, compliance, transparency and continuous improvement 
Location: Brasov or Bucharest
 In this role, you will directly influence financial transparency, compliance and decision-making across Hungary and Romania. You will grow from an execution-focused role into a trusted finance partner , gaining international exposure and building a strong platform for your long-term finance career within the CEE region.
